rooms.name: Ghost Ship Entry Ramp
rooms.desc:
You see before you an ominous looking rickety old plank that seems to dare
you to enter the dark and forboding ship looming before you.  You can hear
what sounds like an unnatural wailing nearby...

rooms.name: Inside The Ghost Ship
rooms.desc:
As you enter the ghastly ship, it feels almost like you've entered another
world.  A glowing fog seems to flicker in and out of the shadows all 
around you.  It seems you are in the lower storage compartment of the ship.
It is eerily silent here as you stand in the entrance...

rooms.name: Cargo Room
rooms.desc:
All about you are ancient looking cargo boxes.  All of the contents are 
rotted beyond any recognizable identification.  The floor boards below your
feet give a low moaning creaking sound.

rooms.name: A Corridor
rooms.desc:
As you explore into the further reaches of the vessel, you become 
startlingly aware of how almost tangible the evil and darkness is here.
The low moaning sound that has accompanied you throughout this vessel
seems especially louder nearby...

rooms.name: The Brig
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the corridor of the brig.  Wails of pain seem to 
eminate from the walls all about you, and almost drive you insane.
The floorboards creak under you with each step, and make a noise not
unlike that of dripping water.

rooms.name: Guard Post
rooms.desc:
This small indescript area is comprised of little more than an old chair.
Various torture devices lay about in gross disrepair.

rooms.name: A Prison Cell
rooms.desc:
Your in a small area surrounded by old, rusty bars, some broken with age,
others surprisingly strong.  Mold and mildew litter the floor, and there 
is a thoroughly unappetizing smell all around you.  Various bones litter
the floor about you.

rooms.name: The Galley
rooms.desc:
You have entered the ship's galley.  Old rusting pots and pans in a state
of disrepair litter the area.  All about you lie mounds of some vile
material mixed with the dust of the ages, forming a thoroughly 
unnappetizing mess.  Tables and chairs, strewn about in a helter skelter
fashion, are slowly falling apart.

rooms.name: The Upper Deck
rooms.desc:
you are standing on the upper deck of the ship.  Scattered here and there
are smashed boxes and heaps of rotting ropes.  The skies are mostly 
concealed by the dank, old sails whipping about in the eery silence.  What
sky you can see is a strange emptiness exuding a bitter cold that gets
colder as you progress further, almost as if trying to stop you.

rooms.name: The Upper Deck

colder as you progress further, almost as if trying to stop you.  Beside you
is an old rope ladder leading up into the void, running parallel to the

rooms.name: The Helm
rooms.desc:
An ageless imperfect wheel sets precariously on a rusted out base here,
serving as the means of steering this vessel.

rooms.name: Before the ship's cabin.
rooms.desc:
You are standing on the threshold of one of the most evil places you have
ever come across.  The dark, foreboding cabin before you has a physical
evilness seeping from it at every nook and cranny.  The walls of the cabin
seem alive with ancient souls, damned to forever ride this vessel from
beyond...

rooms.name: Ship's Cabin
rooms.desc:
You have entered a room that emits an almost tangible evil.  All about 
you is darkness and you feel like you are blanketed in cold.  The only 
light for this chamber seems to be originating from further inside these
chambers...

rooms.name: Captain's Chambers
rooms.desc:
As you enter the cabin's inner sanctum, you see to your right a large
richly decorated bed, covered in mold and in a terrible state of decay.
Against the right wall rests what appears to be a broken desk and rotted
chair setting by it.  Ancient medallions and parchments line the walls and
floor, either earned or stolen, the truth lost to time.  Your senses tell
you that you have found the chambers of this vessel's captain...

rooms.name: Rope ladder
rooms.desc:
You are climbing a rickity old ladder up into the unknown.  All around 
you is darkness, and a cold wind whips against you.

rooms.name: Rope ladder
rooms.desc:
You are climbing a rickity old ladder up into the unknown.  All around 
you is darkness, and a cold wind whips against you.

rooms.name: Rope ladder
rooms.desc:

rooms.name: Crow's Nest
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a pulpit, suspended high above the vessel below you.
A broken barrier stands about you preventing your fall to the deck below.
There is an ethereal blue glowing mist as far as the eye can see in every
direction....

rooms.name: Main Deck
rooms.desc:
As far as the eye can see beyond this vessel is an ethereal blue glowing
mist.  Your every sense tells you to avoid jumping over the edge of the
boat.  Thank the fates there is an old, rickety wooden barrier to prevent
your fall into the stygian mists below.  Beside you, a plank is extended
out toward the strange unknown, and blood is splattered all over the end
opposite where you are currently standing...

rooms.name: The Plank
rooms.desc:
The plank you are standing on looks as if it can barely support your weight.
All about you is a soundless void....

rooms.name: The Head
rooms.desc:
You have entered an area of the utmost filth and stench.  You have entered
the bathroom of this ship of the damned.  Before you is a totally rotted 
toilet.  Lying about are smelly rotten rags, seemingly falling apart even
as you look at them.  You wager a guess that this room hasn't had much use
for many years considering the condition of the crew....

rooms.name: Bottom Deck
rooms.desc:
You are at the bottom floor of the immense vessel.  You wager a guess that
this used to be the living quarters of the ship's crew, as there are
overturned rotting beds all about, with bedstuffing lying about in clumps.
Destroyed furniture lies about everywhere, and nondescript personal
belongings of a long dead crew line the walls, and mix in with the 
bedstuffing.  What a mess!
